units.source_text: 他只对一个男人寄予了一定的信赖。

en.t: He placed a certain amount of trust in only one man.

units.source_text: 那个男人老是像刚洗过脸似的，眼皮肿肿的。

en.t: That man always looked as if he had just washed his face, with swollen eyelids.

units.source_text: 那是个热心搞工会运动的人。

en.t: He was a man devoted to the labor union movement.

units.source_text: 他甚至老老实实地向那个人表露过对别人难以宣照的真心。

en.t: He had even honestly revealed to that man the true feelings he found hard to disclose to others.
